audit.why: Both layers and packet.levelChart agree on Fizz for all seven rows, and that matches the kit: Anivia has no dash, no reset and one long-cooldown engage tool, so Fizz owns every stage he can bait Flash Frost. Nothing to move.
audit.corrected: Chart left untouched. The whys were rewritten only where they were misgendered or carried an unsourced magnitude.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[5].why and breakdown.spikes claimed the string 'one-shots squishies' with no source; content.late claimed 'your burst combo kills her before her egg-respawn passive even matters'.
audit.why: Rebirth's text is explicit: on fatal damage she reverts to an egg and is reborn at full health. The egg is a second health bar you have to break — it is exactly the thing that DOES matter in a duel, and the page told the player the opposite.
audit.corrected: Spike text restated on real timings, and Rebirth written in as damage you must budget for rather than something you outrun.

audit.whatIsWrong: TWO fabrications pointing opposite directions. (a) spikes[1].text, whys[3] and content.mid said Chum the Waters ROOTS her through Glacial Storm. (b) content.early and wants.you[1] told the player to save the E jump to 'hop her Crystallize (W) wall' — the exact opposite of what the kit says.
audit.why: Fizz's R text is a slow followed by 'knocking up the target' — no root anywhere in it. Crystallize carries the terrain flag ('creates terrain, blocks paths and dashes'), and Fizz's E and Q both carry the dash flag whose own note reads 'mobility that grounding and walls can deny'. The wall is what STOPS the hop, not something the hop beats. A player following the old advice walks into the wall at low HP.
audit.corrected: R restated as a knockup landed inside the storm. Crystallize restated as a 17-second wall that blocks both of your dashes — go around it, and hold E for the Flash Frost stun instead. Also stated the interaction the page only half-carried: Frostbite doubles only against a target chilled by Flash Frost or a fully formed Glacial Storm, so dodging the sphere removes the doubling, not just the stun.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns held no digit (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT) despite Flash Frost's cooldown being the whole matchup.
audit.why: Flash Frost is 11/10/9/8/7, Crystallize a flat 17, Frostbite a flat 4, Glacial Storm 4/3/2. The gap between an 11-second Q and a 4-second E is the entire trading rhythm and none of it was on the page.
audit.corrected: All four written in, with the step-up window keyed to the missed Flash Frost.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was the tradeGood string verbatim and dontsFull[2].d was the tradeBad string verbatim, under unrelated titles (lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED). Nineteen further fields called Anivia 'he/his/him'.
audit.why: Bodies did not match their titles; the pronouns came from a template written for a male enemy.
audit.corrected: Both bodies rewritten to their own titles, and all misgender findings fixed.
